Are there problems that can arise from this? Yes - as it has been studied in other scouting organizations across the world who do and have allowed females for decades the tendency is for females to take a large portion of leadership roles at a younger age (think 13-15 years old) but it then typically reverses to males older (16-18) (depending on the leadership role, what im saying is way over simplified but is the gist) this could result in less 'leadership training' for younger males - but if you have a troop of 20 kids all boys, allow girls in and now you have 40 sure you might lose some of the leadership roles to girls but you've also doubled the opportunity.
